name: Gods Help
overview: Scripture reveals that God is our constant helper and refuge, providing strength and support in every circumstance. As the Lord is our shepherd, we lack nothing, and He upholds our souls with His righteous hand. Believers are called to trust wholly in the Lord rather than their own understanding, confident that God’s presence dispels fear and brings lasting help. Ultimately, God's greatest assistance is shown in the gift of His Son, Jesus Christ, through whom we receive eternal life.
